thesis: The morning thesis is intact. SIBN is still in an uptrend (last 24.76 above SMA20 22.24, SMA50 20.18 and SMA200 16.68; ret_63 +30.7%, rs_63 0.36). The Q3 print still supports it (revenue +14.49% YoY, narrowing loss, cash 146,260,000 vs debt 42,801,000), and healthcare still leads a risk-off tape. Today's fade from the 25.10 prior close to 24.76 is on light partial-session volume (305,903). It holds well above the 23.39 post-gap low and has put price inside the 24.0-24.9 entry zone. That looks like the pullback the morning card waited for, not a breakdown. Entry is now set at the live price of 24.76 instead of the 24.45 mid-entry. From there reward/risk is about 2.5 (3.63 / 1.46), still above 1.5, and the stop is now about 1.2 ATR away instead of 0.9.
invalidation: A daily close below 23.3, under the Nov 9 low of 23.39, or a close back inside the Nov 3 gap below about 23.77, invalidates the post-earnings base.
key_risks: Afternoon news could not be refreshed (proxy 403, news_7d empty), and the morning news card also had no feed. An offering, analyst action or other headline today cannot be ruled out, and the light-volume fade has not been checked against news
The target of 28.39 (52-week high 25.92 + 2 x ATR 1.2354) needs a breakout. Today's high of 25.47 is a second failure below 25.92 after the Nov 9 high of 25.74
Stop is still tight for a 5% ATR stock: 23.3 is about 1.2 ATR below 24.76, so normal noise can trigger it
Price is near the mean analyst target of 26.78 and still 11% above SMA20 (RSI 65.3). Sequential revenue dipped from 56,010,000 to 55,704,000, and Q3 guidance and beat/miss detail are unverified
Broad risk-off regime (QQQ below its 50- and 200-day averages, 21-day -9.55%), and short interest of 11.68% of float raises the risk of a sharp reversal
Do not chase: no entry above 24.9. A limit in the lower half of the zone (about 24.45) gives reward/risk of about 3.4 compared with about 2.5 at 24.76
